tools.description: Add/remove controls, nulls, and bones in a ControlRig hierarchy and set control settings — the part of ControlRig that IS Python-scriptable.

tools.name: control_rig_bake_to_sequence
tools.description: Bake a ControlRig's animation in a level sequence down to a new AnimSequence — the production path for hand-keyed/procedural rig output. Job-envelope.

tools.name: sequence_bake_to_control_rig
tools.description: Bake an existing AnimSequence onto an FK ControlRig track in a level sequence (so animators can tweak captured/retargeted anim) — reverse of the above.

tools.name: anim_preview_render
tools.parity: GenOrca vision overlay / Roblox capture; reuses our strongest moat
tools.description: Vision verify: spawn/pose a preview SkeletalMeshActor with a sequence/montage at time t, auto-frame on bounds, capture viewport PNG (image content block) — before/after the agent's edit.

tools.name: anim_play_in_editor_test
tools.description: Spawn a preview actor playing an anim/montage in PIE, sample N screenshots across the timeline, and report (loop/blend sanity) — gameplay verify without leaving the loop.

tools.name: anim_validate
tools.description: Run PLUMB/validator + structural checks on an anim asset (skeleton-compat, missing curves, broken montage slot, retarget root unset) before/after mutate — the closed-loop correctness gate.

tools.name: anim_checkpoint
tools.description: Domain dry-run/checkpoint+restore wrapper: snapshot an anim asset (or AnimBP) before a risky multi-step edit and roll back as ONE undo if validate fails — generalizes world_generate's dry_run→commit.

domains.summary: No UE MCP competitor ships real audio authoring depth, so almost everything here is a net-new moat; the cheapest, highest-ROI strategy is python_run-backed wrappers (USoundCue/USoundClass/USoundMix/USoundSubmix/USoundAttenuation/UReverbEffect are all freely authorable via UE Editor-Scripting with zero plugin rebuild). The two existing C++ surfaces (HaybaMCPAudioHandler 3 cmds, HaybaMCPMetaSound create/list) get thin first-class wrappers, and the deferred MetaSound graph-mutation gap is honestly scoped to template-instantiation + default-input setting + interface introspection rather than fabricating unstable FrontendDocumentBuilder calls. Every write domain ships a paired read tool (audio_inspect) and a soundcue/submix dry-run, and all mutations route through a C++ FScopedTransaction seam so a multi-node SoundCue build is ONE Ctrl+Z, the named differentiator vs Epic's per-call undo. We lean into PLUMB-style audio_validate (no dangling nodes, 3D sounds require attenuation, submix loops detected) as the closed-loop correctness engine no audio competitor has.
dependencies: UE Editor-Scripting (unreal Python): EditorAssetLibrary, AssetToolsHelpers, NewObject for USoundCue/USoundClass/USoundMix/USoundSubmix/USoundAttenuation/USoundConcurrency/UReverbEffect
Existing C++ HaybaMCPAudioHandler (audio_play, audio_list, audio_set_volume), extend not rewrite
Existing HaybaMCPMetaSound plugin (metasound_create, metasound_list working; add_node/connect/set_input/compile deferred)
Hardened python_run handler (SEH + 3-tier gate + dangling-delegate gate) as dispatch vehicle for all TS wrappers
Theme 1 add-a-tool refactor: ToolDescriptor with pyTemplate factory so these land with zero per-tool 7-file churn
C++ FScopedTransaction seam (Theme 4C) shared across handlers for audio_transaction_*/audio_undo
PLUMB validator hook (validator_run / plumb_validate) for audio_validate integration
Interchange / AssetImportTask for soundwave_import; AudioMixerBlueprintLibrary + PIE for submix_bounce_to_wav; AudioModulation plugin for modulation_control_bus_create
MetasoundEngine/MetasoundFrontend modules already linked in HaybaMCPMetaSound.Build.cs for metasound_inspect/set_default_input
risks: MetaSound graph mutation (add_node/connect/compile) is genuinely unstable across UE 5.3-5.7 FrontendDocumentBuilder; DO NOT fabricate, honestly scope to template-instantiation + set_default_input + inspect, flagged engine limitation (matches existing deferred-stub decision in HaybaMCPMetaSoundHandler.cpp)
metasound_set_default_input/inspect need verification that 5.7 frontend exposes stable member-default getters/setters; may need C++ and could itself be partially deferred
SoundCue graph construction via Python (construct_sound_node / first_node) is known but node-class names + pin wiring are version-sensitive; sound_cue_edit_graph needs per-version smoke tests
submix_bounce_to_wav requires active PIE and writes to disk; PIE is itself a gap area and offline audio render can hang the game thread; keep duration short, run under wait_for_idle, P3 only
audio_play uses GWorld + PlaySound2D which only audibly works with an editor audio device / PIE; in -nullrhi or headless CI it silently no-ops, return a clear 'no audio device' code not false success
Audio Modulation is a plugin that may not be enabled; modulation tool must detect-and-degrade gracefully

Transaction-wrapping Python-side mutations won't be captured by C++ FScopedTransaction (per brief 4C); audio_undo reliably covers only C++ handler mutations, Python authoring needs unreal.ScopedEditorTransaction inside the pyTemplate, document the split
SetTransientPrimaryVolume (existing audio_set_volume 'master') is transient and lost on PIE restart; soundmix_set_adjuster is the durable path, deprecate the stub category arg honestly
domains.test_plan: On a live UE 5.7 editor with HaybaMCPToolkit + HaybaMCPMetaSound loaded and a project containing a few SoundWaves: (1) audio_list class_filter=SoundWave to confirm read path + pagination. (2) sound_cue_create template='random' over 3 waves, then audio_inspect the new cue to confirm graph_nodes match, then audio_validate for 0 violations; deliberately create a 3D cue without attenuation and confirm audio_validate flags it. (3) soundclass_create music with parent, soundmix_set_adjuster ducking music -6dB, assign_sound_to_class the cue, audio_inspect to verify SoundClassOverride. (4) submix_create Reverb under Master, submix_add_effect type='reverb', submix_send_set the cue to it, audio_inspect submix to confirm effect chain + send. (5) attenuation_create + attenuation_assign + ambient_sound_spawn at a location; editor_capture_viewport to confirm the AmbientSound actor placed. (6) Wrap steps 2-5 in audio_transaction_begin/commit, then audio_undo(1) and re-inspect to confirm the whole bundle reverted in one step (Ctrl+Z parity proof). (7) metasound_create, metasound_instantiate_template from a known template, metasound_inspect to list interface inputs, metasound_set_default_input on a float param, re-inspect to confirm new_value; if set_default_input returns the deferred error log it honestly as engine-limited. (8) Run every write tool once with dry_run=true and diff against the committed result to verify dry-run fidelity. (9) Start PIE, audio_play the cue + submix_bounce_to_wav 2s, confirm a non-empty wav on disk; in headless/-nullrhi confirm audio_play returns 'no audio device' rather than false success.

tools.name: audio_inspect
tools.parity: net-new moat (no UE MCP introspects audio assets)
tools.description: Universal read-back for any sound asset (SoundWave/Cue/MetaSound/Class/Mix/Submix/Attenuation/Concurrency/ReverbEffect): resolved properties, cue/submix graph summary, MetaSound interface, the inspection-first paired read tool that makes every write verifiable.

tools.name: audio_list
tools.parity: self (C++ audio_list exists, no TS wrapper)
tools.signature: (class_filter?, path_prefix?, limit=50, offset=0) -> {sounds[], count, has_more, next_offset}
tools.description: Paginated list of sound assets filtered by class (SoundWave/SoundCue/MetaSoundSource/SoundClass/Submix/...) and path prefix with duration/sample-rate tags, first-class wrapper over the existing C++ audio_list extended with class filter + pagination.

tools.name: sound_cue_create
tools.signature: (package_path, name, waves[], template='single', looping=false, dry_run=false) -> {path, nodes_created, ok}
tools.description: Create a USoundCue from one or more SoundWaves with a chosen template (single/looping/random/mixer/randomized-pitch) wired in one shot, the core authoring outcome-verb that turns raw waves into game-ready cues.

tools.name: sound_cue_edit_graph
tools.parity: net-new moat (GenOrca has material-graph, none have cue-graph)
tools.signature: (cue_path, ops[{op:add|connect|set|remove, node_type?, node_id?, to_id?, props?}], dry_run=false) -> {applied, graph_nodes[], ok}
tools.description: Add / connect / set / remove SoundCue graph nodes (Mixer, Random, Looping, Modulator, Concatenator, Attenuation, Delay, WavePlayer) on an existing cue, fine-grained graph authoring beyond the create templates.

tools.name: soundclass_create
tools.description: Create a USoundClass, set its parent in the mixing hierarchy, and apply default properties (volume, pitch, output bus, LFE), the routing backbone for music/sfx/ui/voice channel control.

tools.name: soundmix_set_adjuster
tools.signature: (mix_path, name, adjusters[{sound_class, vol, pitch, apply_to_children}], dry_run=false) -> {path, adjuster_count, ok}
tools.description: Create/edit a USoundMix and set per-SoundClass volume/pitch/EQ adjusters (the data behind ducking, stealth-muffle, menu-dim), replaces the C++ stub that only supports 'master' transient volume.

tools.name: submix_create
tools.description: Create a USoundSubmix and set its parent submix routing, establishes the DSP bus topology (Reverb bus, Music bus, Master) that effect chains attach to.

tools.name: submix_add_effect
tools.signature: (submix_path, effect_type, params{}, index=-1, dry_run=false) -> {effect_preset_path, chain[], ok}
tools.description: Append/insert a submix effect preset (Reverb, Submix EQ, Dynamics/Compressor, Filter, Convolution-reverb, Tap-delay) into a submix effect chain with typed params, productionizing the DSP layer competitors don't touch.

tools.name: attenuation_create
tools.signature: (package_path, name, falloff_min, falloff_max, shape='sphere', enable_occlusion=false, enable_spatialization=true) -> {path, ok}
tools.description: Create a USoundAttenuation asset with spatialization, distance-falloff curve, air-absorption, occlusion and focus settings, required correctness data for any 3D positioned sound.

tools.name: metasound_create
tools.description: Create a blank UMetaSoundSource asset, first-class TS wrapper over the working C++ HaybaMCPMetaSound create command.

tools.name: metasound_instantiate_template
tools.description: Duplicate a known-good template MetaSoundSource/Patch and rename it, the honest ceiling-aware way to ship MetaSound authoring given UE 5.7's unstable FrontendDocumentBuilder instead of fabricating graph-mutation calls.

tools.name: metasound_set_default_input
tools.signature: (metasound_path, input_name, value, type='float') -> {input_name, old_value, new_value, ok}
tools.description: Set the default value of a named graph input / interface member on a MetaSoundSource (param packs), the stable mutation surface that survives the 5.7 builder churn, enabling parameterized sound design.

tools.name: metasound_inspect
tools.description: Read a MetaSound's interface (inputs/outputs with types+defaults), declared interfaces, and referenced patches/graphs, paired read tool so agents can discover settable params before mutating.

tools.name: metasound_list
tools.description: Paginated list of MetaSoundSource/Patch assets under a path, first-class wrapper over the working C++ metasound_list.

tools.name: audio_transaction_begin
tools.description: Open a named FScopedTransaction so a multi-step audio authoring bundle (cue + class + submix wiring) collapses into ONE Ctrl+Z, the named safety differentiator vs Epic's per-call undo.

tools.name: audio_transaction_commit
tools.description: Close the open audio transaction, finalizing all wrapped mutations as a single undo unit.

tools.name: audio_undo
tools.description: Undo the last audio authoring transaction (and redo) via the editor transactor, safe rollback for agent mistakes.

tools.name: audio_validate
tools.description: PLUMB-style quantified check on a cue/submix/MetaSound: dangling/unreachable nodes, 3D sound missing attenuation, submix parent cycles, missing wave references, clipping gain sums, closed-loop validate-before/after-mutate no audio competitor has.

tools.name: assign_sound_to_class
tools.description: Set the SoundClassOverride on one SoundBase (cue/wave/metasound) so it inherits the right mixing channel, the connective tissue between assets and the class hierarchy.

tools.name: attenuation_assign
tools.description: Attach a SoundAttenuation (and optional concurrency) to a cue/wave/metasound default or to an AmbientSound actor, makes a sound spatial without manual editor clicks.

tools.name: concurrency_create
tools.description: Create a USoundConcurrency asset (max-count, resolution rule, volume-scale duck), voice-limiting data that prevents audio-channel exhaustion in dense scenes.

tools.name: reverb_effect_create
tools.signature: (package_path, name, decay_time=1.5, density=1.0, gain=0.32, params{}) -> {path, ok}
tools.description: Create a UReverbEffect asset with density/decay/diffusion/gain params for use by audio volumes or the reverb submix, environmental DSP authoring.

tools.name: ambient_sound_spawn
tools.description: Spawn an AAmbientSound actor at a world location wired to a cue/metasound + attenuation with autoplay flag, places diegetic sound in the level in one outcome-verb.

tools.name: audio_component_add
tools.description: Add a UAudioComponent to an existing actor with sound/volume/pitch/auto-activate set, attaches sound to gameplay objects (engines, doors, props).

tools.name: soundwave_import
tools.description: Import wav/ogg/flac files into the project via Interchange/AssetImportTask with target package path and basic compression settings, feeds raw audio into the authoring pipeline.

tools.name: soundwave_set_properties
tools.description: Batch-set properties on many SoundWaves (looping, compression quality, streaming, force-mono, volume/pitch multipliers), bulk asset hygiene over a selection or query.

tools.name: audio_batch_assign
tools.signature: (query{class,path_prefix}, sound_class?, attenuation?, concurrency?, dry_run=false) -> {matched, updated, sample[], ok}
tools.description: Batch-assign SoundClass / Attenuation / Concurrency across many sounds matched by class+path query, outcome-verb for wiring a whole folder of SFX to the right mixing setup at once.

tools.name: submix_send_set
tools.signature: (sound_path, base_submix?, sends[{submix, level_db}], dry_run=false) -> {sound, sends[], ok}
tools.description: Set a sound's base submix and submix sends (with send level), routes individual sounds into reverb/music/master buses completing the DSP graph wiring.

tools.name: audio_play
tools.description: Preview-play a cue/wave/metasound 2D in the editor at volume/pitch, first-class wrapper over the existing C++ audio_play for the audition feedback loop.

tools.name: audio_stop_all
tools.description: Stop all active editor preview audio voices, cleanup verb so chained auditions don't pile up.

tools.name: submix_bounce_to_wav
tools.description: Record a submix's output to a wav file during PIE (StartRecordingOutput/FinishRecordingOutput), offline audition/diff artifact for the feedback loop, flagged PIE-dependent.

tools.name: modulation_control_bus_create
tools.description: Create an Audio Modulation control bus + modulator (LFO/envelope-follower) for parameter-driven mixing, advanced runtime control requiring the AudioModulation plugin.

domains.summary: World Partition, runtime streaming, Data Layers, and Level Instances are the connective tissue of any large UE5 open world and a hard gap versus every competitor (Epic baseline, Aura, Flop, GenOrca ship essentially nothing here). Today Hayba has only 3 thin C++ commands (wp_get_cells, wp_load_cell stubbed, wp_get_streaming_state stubbed) and no Data Layer or Level Instance surface at all. The strategy is python_run-first: UE's DataLayerEditorSubsystem, WorldPartitionBlueprintLibrary, LevelInstanceSubsystem, and EditorLevelUtils cover ~90% of the authoring loop with zero plugin rebuild, so we ship breadth fast and reserve C++ for the two existing stubs and a fast cell-aggregation read path. Every write tool gets a paired *_inspect read tool, a dry_run preview, query-based batch selection (matching Roblox peer mass_* verbs), and FScopedTransaction/undo grouping so a multi-actor data-layer assignment is one Ctrl+Z. This domain is a net-new moat: spatial/streaming worldbuilding correctness nobody else automates, feeding PLUMB validation (e.g. no gameplay actor outside a runtime data layer).
dependencies: Theme 0 job-envelope async conversion must land before wp_build_hlod (HLOD build is long-running and would otherwise freeze the game thread, same bug class as build_*/test_run).

Theme 4C transaction seam (FScopedTransaction begin/end-transaction in C++): wp_transaction_group and full transaction-wrapping of mutating tools depend on it; Python ScopedEditorTransaction does NOT capture C++ handler mutations but DOES capture python_run actor edits, so python tools can self-wrap in the interim.
PLUMB validator + constraint language (wp_validate_streaming registers WP-specific rules into validator_run).
A World-Partition-enabled test map with multiple runtime grids + existing data layers for live validation; most tools degrade to clear 'WP not enabled' / 'no data layers' errors otherwise.
ue-python.js helpers (runUePythonJson, pyStr, _emit/_err harness) and the hardened python_run handler back all python wrappers.
Add-a-tool refactor (Theme 1) descriptor + pyTemplate factory so these ~30 wrappers ship as data, not 30x7-file churn.
risks: UE Python WP coverage is uneven in 5.7: load_actors/unload_actors/pin_actors exist, but editor streaming-source injection (wp_simulate_streaming_at) and HLOD build may need C++ or a commandlet fallback; flag as engine-limitation if the Python path is missing rather than shipping a stub (honesty invariant).
Loading large regions (wp_load_region / load_by_query) can spike memory and stall the editor on big worlds; enforce limit caps, return est counts in dry_run first, and pair every load with an unload.

wp_enable / level_instance commit / datalayer_delete are genuinely destructive (level conversion, asset writes, reference fixup): strictly Plan-Mode + confirm + dry_run gated; a bad convert can require an editor restart.

MEMORY: no TCP sockets from UE Python to plugin ports and no AsyncTask(GameThread)+Wait inside handlers; all python tools run via python_run on the game thread, so keep each call short to avoid the HaybaMCP late-response/UAF crash class.

Data Layer API churned across UE versions (legacy ActorDataLayers vs DataLayerAsset/Instance in 5.7); pin to the 5.7 DataLayerEditorSubsystem surface and detect-and-error on older shapes rather than guessing.
Existing C++ wp_list_cells buckets by a hardcoded 51200 cell size with a 100 cap; must read the real per-grid cell size and paginate or counts will mislead the agent.
domains.test_plan: On a live editor with a World-Partition map (multiple runtime grids + 2-3 existing data layers): 1) Read path first: wp_inspect, wp_list_cells (verify pagination has_more/next_offset), wp_get_streaming_state (confirm the previously-stubbed handler now returns real sources/loaded cells), datalayer_list, level_instance_list; cross-check counts against the WP editor outliner. 2) Data-layer round-trip: datalayer_create('Test_DL', Runtime) -> datalayer_assign_by_query(class='StaticMeshActor', dry_run=true) inspect matched -> run for real -> datalayer_inspect to confirm membership -> datalayer_set_editor_loaded(false) + editor_capture_viewport to visually confirm actors vanish -> set_editor_loaded(true) -> datalayer_remove_actors -> datalayer_delete; verify a SINGLE Ctrl+Z (via wp_transaction_group) reverts the assign batch. 3) Streaming: wp_load_region(dry_run) compare would_load vs real loaded_actor_count via wp_inspect delta, then wp_unload_region restores; wp_simulate_streaming_at over a known landmark and confirm reported cells match wp_list_cells bounds. 4) Validation: introduce a gameplay actor with no data layer, run wp_validate_streaming, confirm it is flagged with a fix_hint, assign it, re-run, confirm clean. 5) Safety: confirm wp_enable / datalayer_delete / level_instance_break refuse without confirm=true and emit a dry_run preview; confirm wp_build_hlod returns a job_id immediately (editor stays responsive) and polls to completion. Capture before/after viewport PNGs for each visible change rather than trusting counts alone.

tools.name: wp_inspect
tools.module: python_run-backed TS (WorldPartitionBlueprintLibrary + UWorldPartition); hot-path upgrade into C++ HaybaMCPWorldPartitionHandler
tools.parity: net-new moat (no UE MCP has WP introspection)
tools.signature: () -> {enabled, grids[], cell_size, streaming_sources, actors:{loaded,unloaded,total}, data_layers, level_instances}
tools.description: One-call world overview (WP enabled, runtime grids, cell size, streaming-source count, loaded/unloaded actors, data-layer + level-instance counts) so every other tool can read-first and branch.

tools.name: wp_list_cells
tools.module: C++ HaybaMCPWorldPartitionHandler (extend wp_get_cells with pagination + loaded flag + real cell size)
tools.signature: (grid?, limit=50, offset=0, only_nonempty?) -> {cells:[{cell_id,bounds,actor_count,top_classes[],loaded}], total, has_more, next_offset}
tools.description: Paginated list of runtime/streaming cells with bounds, actor count, top classes, loaded state; replaces the 100-cap C++ wp_get_cells with honest pagination so agents can reason about spatial layout.

tools.name: wp_get_streaming_state
tools.description: Finish the stubbed handler: report active streaming sources (location/radius/priority), loaded cells, and pending load/unload so agents can verify what the runtime would stream.

tools.name: wp_load_region
tools.description: Load all WP actors whose bounds intersect a world-space box/sphere into the editor (the real fix for stubbed wp_load_cell) so later edits/captures actually see them; without this, edits silently no-op on unloaded actors.

tools.name: wp_unload_region
tools.description: Unload editor-loaded WP actors in a region to free memory and restore a clean streaming state after batch edits; inverse of wp_load_region, key for keeping large worlds responsive.

tools.name: wp_load_actors_by_query
tools.signature: (class?, tag?, name_contains?, data_layer?, limit=200, dry_run?) -> {matched, loaded, actor_paths[]}
tools.description: Load WP actors matching a class/tag/name/data-layer query (not just spatial) so an agent can pull e.g. all foliage or all of DataLayer 'Combat' into the editor before mutating them.

tools.name: wp_pin_actors
tools.description: Pin specific WP actors so they stay loaded regardless of streaming-source position; needed for stable multi-step authoring on a known actor set.

tools.name: wp_unpin_actors
tools.description: Release pinned WP actors so normal streaming resumes; paired inverse of wp_pin_actors to avoid leaking forced-loaded actors.

tools.name: wp_simulate_streaming_at
tools.description: Add a temporary editor streaming source at a world position and report which cells/actors would load: a 'what would the player see here' dry-run, the killer verify tool for streaming correctness.

tools.name: wp_set_runtime_grid
tools.description: Set an actor's RuntimeGrid placement (coarse grid for large landmarks, fine for gameplay props) so streaming granularity matches design intent.

tools.name: wp_enable
tools.module: python_run-backed TS (WorldPartition conversion utils); commandlet fallback if Python path missing
tools.description: Enable World Partition on the current/specified level (or report why not), Plan-Mode gated since it is a destructive level conversion; the on-ramp for non-WP worlds.

tools.name: wp_build_hlod
tools.module: python_run-backed TS dispatch + job-envelope (mirror Theme 0 build-handler async pattern)
tools.parity: remiphilippe (headless build) partial; net-new for WP HLOD
tools.description: Kick the WP HLOD build as a job-envelope async command (not a blocking game-thread call) and poll status; regenerate HLOD proxies for distant cells without freezing the editor.

tools.name: datalayer_create
tools.description: Create a DataLayerAsset + instance with name, type (Editor/Runtime), and initial state; foundational Data Layer authoring tool no competitor offers.

tools.name: datalayer_list
tools.description: List all data layers with type, runtime state, editor loaded/visible flags, parent, and assigned-actor count; inspect-first companion for the whole data-layer surface.

tools.name: datalayer_inspect
tools.signature: (name | asset_path, limit=50, offset=0) -> {layer{...}, actors[], children[], has_more}
tools.description: Deep read of one data layer: hierarchy, every assigned actor (paginated), effective runtime/editor state; drill-down to verify assignments before/after a mutation.

tools.name: datalayer_delete
tools.description: Delete a data layer (optionally reassigning its actors), transaction-wrapped and Plan-Mode gated; clean removal without orphaning actor references.

tools.name: datalayer_rename
tools.description: Rename/relabel a data layer asset and fix up references; unglamorous but needed for iterative worldbuilding cleanup.

tools.name: datalayer_assign_actors
tools.description: Add a list of actors to a data layer in ONE transaction (one Ctrl+Z) with membership read-back; core authoring verb for organizing a world into streaming groups.

tools.name: datalayer_remove_actors
tools.description: Remove actors from a data layer in one transaction with read-back; paired inverse so membership edits are reversible and verifiable.

tools.name: datalayer_assign_by_query
tools.signature: (name, class?, tag?, name_contains?, region?, dry_run=true, limit=1000) -> {matched, assigned, sample_paths[]}
tools.description: Assign every actor matching a class/tag/name/region query to a data layer (outcome-verb over primitives), e.g. put all Light actors in DataLayer Lighting, in one batched dry-run-able call.

tools.name: datalayer_set_runtime_state
tools.description: Set a data layer's runtime state (Unloaded/Loaded/Activated) to simulate/preview gameplay streaming behavior in-editor; verify which content gates on which layer.

tools.name: datalayer_set_editor_loaded
tools.description: Load/unload a data layer's actors in the editor so the agent (and vision capture) can see or hide a content group while authoring.

tools.name: datalayer_set_visible
tools.description: Toggle a data layer's editor visibility without unloading; fast isolate/hide for capture and review workflows.

tools.name: datalayer_actor_membership
tools.description: Read all data layers a given actor belongs to; actor-centric inverse lookup to debug 'why is this actor not streaming'.

tools.name: level_instance_list
tools.description: List Level Instance / Packed Level Actor instances with source level, transform, loaded/edit state; inspect-first for the level-instance loop.

tools.name: level_instance_create_from_actors
tools.description: Pack selected actors into a new Level Instance asset (transaction-wrapped, dry-run preview); the reuse/streaming-unit verb for repeating world chunks.

tools.name: level_instance_spawn
tools.description: Spawn an existing Level Instance asset into the world at a transform; place reusable streaming sub-levels programmatically.

tools.name: level_instance_set_edit
tools.description: Enter or commit/discard edit mode on a Level Instance so its contents can be mutated and saved back; gated since commit writes the asset.

tools.name: level_instance_break
tools.description: Break a Level Instance back into loose actors in the current level (transaction-wrapped, Plan-Mode gated); inverse of pack, for de-instancing.

tools.name: wp_validate_streaming
tools.module: python_run-backed TS feeding validator_run / PLUMB constraints
tools.parity: net-new moat (PLUMB validator extension; beyond Flop auto-repair)
tools.description: PLUMB-fed correctness pass: flag gameplay actors with no data layer, actors outside any cell, empty/oversized cells, layers with no runtime state, dangling level-instance refs; closed-loop validate-before/after-mutate, our moat applied to WP.

tools.name: wp_transaction_group
tools.module: C++ HaybaMCPToolkit transaction seam (FScopedTransaction; reuse Theme 4C begin/end-transaction)
tools.description: Begin/end a named transaction around a batch of WP/data-layer mutations so multi-tool sequences collapse into ONE Ctrl+Z; the cross-cutting safety differentiator vs Epic per-call undo, applied here.

domains.summary: Today this domain is a thin shim: four HTTP connectors (PolyHaven/AmbientCG/Sketchfab/Fab) that pipe files through one undifferentiated python_run AssetImportTask loop (save=False, no options, no read-back of what was created), plus a single-file C++ asset_import/asset_duplicate and the project asset_retriever index. The author loop is invisible: you cannot say "import this FBX with lightmap UVs, dry-run first, then verify tri counts and save." Strategy: (1) replace the dumb import with outcome-verb Interchange wrappers (mesh/texture/HDRI/USD/Datasmith/folder) carrying real options plus a dry_run->commit and read-back pair, all python_run-backed so they ship with zero plugin rebuilds; (2) collapse the four connectors behind unified asset_source_search/download verbs and add the cross-DCC moat -- async AI-3D/texture generation (generate->poll->import, stolen from Blender Hyper3D); (3) fill the unglamorous gaps competitors skip -- dependency reports, asset validation, redirector fixup, save-dirty, source-repoint reimport, paginated catalog browse, docs-as-a-tool. Every write tool is transaction-tagged and Plan-Mode-gated with structured outputs + machine error codes so the agent never guesses whether an import silently SyntaxError'd.
dependencies: python_run handler (hardened SEH + 3-tier security gate) -- execution vehicle for ~24 of these tools; no plugin rebuild

asset-sources/shared.ts (importIntoUe, verifyAndMarkDelta, DAG sink, cachePathFor, downloadToFile/extractZip) -- refactor importIntoUe to take Interchange pipeline options and return a created-asset manifest instead of a log string
asset_retriever index (browse/search/reindex) + AssetVerifier -- reused by verify/catalog/dependency tools and delta-marked after each import
Transactions/undo domain (Theme 4C) -- asset_import_* emit FScopedTransaction tags so a multi-file burst collapses to one Ctrl+Z; this domain consumes that seam
Add-a-tool refactor (Theme 1) descriptor + pyTemplate factory -- the vehicle that lets these ~30 ship as data-declared tools
Interchange/USD/Datasmith editor plugins must be enabled in the target .uproject (USDImporter, DatasmithImporter, InterchangeEditor)
Existing connector secret storage (Project Settings -> Hayba MCP -> Asset Connectors) + env fallback (getTokenWithEnvFallback) for new AI-gen provider keys
Vision-feedback domain (4B) for asset_thumbnail image-block return
PLUMB/validator hooks for validate-before/after on destructive rename/relocate
risks: save=False on import is load-bearing: inline save on a fresh import burst has crashed UE in practice; asset_save must be a separate, explicit, idempotent step never auto-chained into import
UE5.7 chokes on one AssetImportTask with many filenames (per shared.ts comment) -- folder/batch import must stay one-task-per-file and report per-file outcomes, not fail the whole batch

Interchange pipeline options surface differs across UE 5.6/5.7/5.8; python_run reflection of pipeline assets is brittle -- pin to documented InterchangeGenericAssetsPipeline fields and degrade gracefully (flag unsupported options, do not error)
asset_rename/relocate generate redirectors; leaving them creates dangling refs and broken cooks -- rename must offer fixup_redirectors and be Plan-Mode-gated + transaction-wrapped

AI-3D-gen providers (Meshy/Tripo/Rodin/Hyper3D) are paid, rate-limited, and return varying topology/scale -- jobs can take minutes; must be async (create/status/import) and never block the game thread; imported gen meshes need scale/pivot normalization
Datasmith/CAD import depends on optional plugins not in every project -- probe availability first (providers/status) and return a not_callable flag rather than a hard crash (honesty invariant)

Silent-success hole: python_run not throwing != import landed (it can SyntaxError into a logged no-op) -- every import MUST round-trip through verifyAndMarkDelta + registry read-back before claiming imported:true
Large mesh/texture imports can exceed the 1MB frame cap and executor timeouts -- return job-style handles for heavy folder imports, align timeouts to UE ceilings
USD Stage Actor vs USD-to-assets are different outcomes; conflating them confuses agents -- expose mode enum explicitly
domains.test_plan: Live-editor validation against a running UE 5.7 project with Interchange/USD/Datasmith plugins enabled, driven through hayba_invoke + python_run. (1) Connectivity: hayba_check_ue_status green, asset_source_providers reports which connector tokens + import plugins are present. (2) Core import happy path: asset_import_dry_run on a known FBX (verify reported meshes/materials/textures match), then asset_import_mesh with generate_lightmap_uvs=true, then asset_import_verify reads back tri count/material slots/registry path; confirm asset_save persists (.uasset on disk, dirty flag cleared). (3) Texture/HDRI: import a PNG (sRGB on) and an .hdr; verify compression settings + that HDRI drives a SkyLight via render_camera/editor_capture_viewport screenshot. (4) USD/Datasmith: import a small .usd stage (both stage-actor and to-assets modes) and a .udatasmith; assert prim/actor counts; on a project lacking the plugin assert not_callable rather than crash. (5) Folder/batch: point at a 10-file folder, assert one-task-per-file, paginated per-file outcome report, and that a single corrupt file does not abort the rest. (6) Sources + AI-gen: asset_source_search 'rock' across providers (paginated), asset_source_download one PBR set and confirm verify; asset_gen_3d_create a text prompt -> poll asset_gen_3d_status to completion -> asset_gen_3d_import and screenshot. (7) Lifecycle/unglamorous: asset_rename then asset_fixup_redirectors (grep registry for redirectors=0), asset_dependency_report on an imported mesh lists its material+textures, asset_validate flags a missing-lightmap-UV mesh, asset_duplicate round-trips. (8) Safety: every destructive tool refused without bPlanApproved; confirm one import burst is a single Ctrl+Z; confirm imported asset survives editor restart. (9) Failure shaping: feed a nonexistent source_file and a path-mismatch dest, assert machine error codes (source_not_found/import_failed/not_in_registry) not stack traces. Capture before/after via editor_capture_viewport and asset_thumbnail.

tools.name: asset_import_mesh
tools.module: python_run-backed TS (refactor shared.ts importIntoUe to carry pipeline options + return manifest)
tools.parity: GenOrca/Flop have FBX import; net-new = options-rich Interchange + structured created-asset manifest
tools.signature: (source_file, dest_path, mesh_type='static'|'skeletal', combine_meshes=true, generate_lightmap_uvs=false, import_materials=true, import_textures=true, build_nanite=false, lod_group?, replace_existing=true) -> {created_assets[{path,class,tris,material_slots}], skipped[], verified, dest_path}
tools.description: Import an FBX/OBJ/glTF/Alembic static or skeletal mesh with real Interchange options (combine meshes, lightmap UVs, import materials/textures, LOD group, build nanite) -- the outcome verb that replaces the optionless single-file asset_import.

tools.name: asset_import_texture
tools.parity: GenOrca has texture import; net-new = first-class compression/flip-green/VT flags
tools.signature: (source_file, dest_path, srgb?, compression='default'|'normalmap'|'masks'|'hdr', flip_green=false, virtual_texture=false, replace_existing=true) -> {path, width, height, format, srgb, compression, verified}
tools.description: Import a texture (PNG/TGA/EXR/PSD) with sRGB, compression setting, virtual-texturing, flip-green-channel, and address mode -- so normal maps and masks land correct without a python detour.

tools.name: asset_import_hdri
tools.parity: PolyHaven connector downloads HDRIs but no first-class HDRI import verb -- net-new
tools.signature: (source_file, dest_path, as='cubemap'|'longlat', apply_to_skylight=false, intensity?) -> {texture_path, skylight_actor?, verified}
tools.description: Import an .hdr/.exr as a long-lat or cubemap and optionally wire it to a SkyLight/skybox -- one outcome verb for lighting-from-image instead of texture+manual setup.

tools.name: asset_import_usd
tools.module: python_run-backed TS (requires USDImporter plugin; probe first)
tools.parity: net-new moat (Blender DCC peer has USD; no UE MCP competitor does)
tools.signature: (source_file, dest_path, mode='stage_actor'|'to_assets', materials='import'|'ignore', merge_meshes=false) -> {mode, actors_or_assets[], prim_count, verified}
tools.description: Import a USD/USDZ stage either as a live USD Stage Actor or flattened to UE assets -- covers the Blender/Houdini USD interop story no UE MCP competitor has.

tools.name: asset_import_datasmith
tools.module: python_run-backed TS (requires DatasmithImporter; returns not_callable if absent)
tools.signature: (source_file, dest_path, import_metadata=true, collision='none'|'auto') -> {root_actor?, created_assets[], verified, plugin_available}
tools.description: Import a .udatasmith / CAD scene via the Datasmith importer -- archviz/CAD ingestion that is entirely absent from every competitor.

tools.name: asset_import_folder
tools.parity: batch-import is net-new among UE MCPs; matches Roblox mass_* ergonomics
tools.signature: (source_dir, dest_path, recursive=true, file_types?[], limit=50, offset=0) -> {imported[], failed[{file,error_code}], has_more, next_offset, total}
tools.description: Batch-import an entire local folder through one pipeline, one AssetImportTask per file (UE5.7-safe), returning a paginated per-file outcome so one bad file never aborts the batch.

tools.name: asset_import_dry_run
tools.parity: Flop has bp_dry_run; net-new for import side
tools.signature: (source_file, mesh_type?) -> {would_create[{name,class}], material_count, texture_count, has_skeleton, anim_count, lod_count, warnings[]}
tools.description: Parse a source file and report exactly what WOULD be created (meshes, material slots, textures, skeleton, animations, LODs) without writing anything -- the dry_run->commit differentiator generalized beyond world_generate.

tools.name: asset_import_inspect_source
tools.signature: (source_file) -> {format, up_axis?, units?, scene_nodes, mesh_count, material_names[], embedded_textures, bone_count?}
tools.description: Read a source file's header/metadata (FBX axis+units+scene graph, glTF node/mesh counts, USD layers/prims) without importing -- inspection-first probe so the agent picks correct options before committing.

tools.name: asset_import_verify
tools.description: Read-back after import: confirm the assets exist in the registry and report mesh stats (tris/vertices/material slots/bounds) or texture dims, closing the silent-success hole where python_run not throwing != import landed.

tools.name: asset_save
tools.description: Explicitly save dirty assets (or a named set) after import -- a separate idempotent step because save=False on a fresh import burst is load-bearing crash-avoidance and must never be auto-chained.

tools.name: asset_reimport
tools.description: Reimport an existing asset from its remembered source, or from a replacement file -- standard authoring loop when the DCC file changes.

tools.name: asset_set_source
tools.description: Repoint an asset's reimport source-file path without reimporting -- fixes broken source links after moving project files.

tools.name: asset_dependency_report
tools.parity: net-new moat (no UE MCP has dependency introspection)
tools.signature: (asset_path, direction='dependencies'|'referencers'|'both', recursive=false, limit=50, offset=0) -> {dependencies[], referencers[], has_more, next_offset}
tools.description: Report an asset's hard/soft dependencies and referencers from the asset registry -- the unglamorous safety read that tells you what an import dragged in and what a delete would break.

tools.name: asset_validate
tools.parity: Houdini graph-intelligence validate / Flop auto-repair -- net-new for imports
tools.description: Run UE's EditorValidatorSubsystem on imported assets (missing material refs, no lightmap UVs, nanite eligibility, broken texture refs) and return structured issues -- validate-after-mutate for the import path.

tools.name: asset_catalog_browse
tools.parity: Unity paginated hierarchy; extends asset_retriever browse
tools.signature: (path='/Game', class_filter?, name_contains?, recursive=false, limit=50, offset=0) -> {entries[{path,class,disk_size}], folders[], has_more, next_offset, total}
tools.description: Paginated browse of a content directory tree with class/name/tag filters -- the inspection surface for finding what already exists before re-importing duplicates.

tools.name: asset_rename
tools.parity: Roblox rename_object; net-new for UE MCP
tools.description: Rename or move an asset, leaving a redirector by default -- Plan-Mode-gated, transaction-wrapped destructive lifecycle op.

tools.name: asset_fixup_redirectors
tools.description: Find and fix up redirectors under a path so cooks and references stay clean after rename/move -- the cleanup step competitors omit and that silently rots projects.

tools.name: asset_duplicate
tools.module: C++ FHaybaMCPAssetHandler (thin TS wrapper, no rebuild)
tools.parity: GenOrca has duplicate; surfacing existing C++ command
tools.description: Duplicate an asset to a new path -- thin first-class wrapper over the existing but unwrapped C++ asset_duplicate command (Theme 2 debt surfacing).

tools.name: asset_thumbnail
tools.parity: Blender/Roblox get_asset_thumbnail; ties into vision-loop moat
tools.description: Generate and return a thumbnail PNG image block for an imported asset -- visual read-back so the agent can confirm an import looks right, not just that it exists.

tools.name: asset_import_pipeline_preset
tools.description: Create/update a reusable named Interchange pipeline preset (default scale, lightmap, material policy) so repeated imports stay consistent and token-cheap.

tools.name: asset_source_search
tools.module: TS (dispatch to existing connector search modules)
tools.description: Unified paginated search across all configured external connectors (PolyHaven/AmbientCG/Sketchfab/Fab) behind one outcome verb -- keeps the eager surface small instead of exposing four search tools.

tools.name: asset_source_download
tools.module: TS (dispatch to existing connector download modules)
tools.signature: (source, id, resolution?, flavour?, dest_path?) -> {cache_path, files[], imported, import_game_path, verified, verify_reason?}
tools.description: Unified download+import of an external asset by {source,id}, routing to the right connector and running the verified import pipeline -- one verb instead of four download tools.

tools.name: asset_source_providers
tools.description: Introspection/status probe: which connectors have tokens configured, which import plugins (USD/Datasmith/Interchange) are available, and which AI-gen providers have keys -- the get_*_status gate before attempting anything.

tools.name: asset_gen_3d_create
tools.module: HTTP/TS (provider key via connector secret store)
tools.parity: Blender Hyper3D/Hunyuan -- net-new for UE MCP
tools.signature: (prompt?, image_url?, provider='meshy'|'tripo'|'rodin', mode='text_to_3d'|'image_to_3d', quality?) -> {job_id, provider, status:'queued'}
tools.description: Submit a text or image prompt to an AI 3D-mesh provider (Meshy/Tripo/Rodin/Hyper3D) and return a job handle -- the cross-DCC moat stolen from Blender's generate->poll->import.

tools.name: asset_gen_3d_status
tools.description: Poll an AI 3D-gen job without blocking the game thread -- the async middle step that makes minutes-long generation safe.

tools.name: asset_gen_3d_import
tools.parity: Blender DCC -- net-new for UE MCP
tools.signature: (job_id, provider, dest_path?, normalize_scale=true, recenter_pivot=true) -> {imported, import_game_path, created_assets[], verified}
tools.description: When a 3D-gen job is done, download the result and run it through the verified import pipeline with scale/pivot normalization -- closes the generate->poll->import loop into UE.

tools.name: asset_gen_texture_create
tools.signature: (prompt, maps?=['basecolor','normal','roughness'], resolution='1k'|'2k', dest_path?) -> {job_id?, imported?, textures[], verified?}
tools.description: Generate a PBR/material texture set from a text prompt via an AI texture provider and import it as a material-ready texture group -- extends the AI-gen moat to surfacing.

tools.name: asset_source_docs
tools.parity: Houdini/remiphilippe docs-as-a-tool -- net-new for UE MCP
tools.description: Docs-as-a-tool: indexed search over UE import API + connector/provider docs so the agent looks up correct Interchange/USD/Datasmith options instead of guessing -- also closes the postmortem 'no reflection-introspection' gap.

tools.name: asset_batch_relocate
tools.parity: Roblox mass ops -- net-new for UE MCP
tools.description: Move many assets to a new folder in one transaction with optional redirector fixup -- batch lifecycle outcome verb, Plan-Mode-gated.

tools.name: asset_import_diff
tools.description: Capture the registry before/after an import and report exactly which assets were created, modified, or replaced -- before/after verification that turns 'import seemed to work' into a precise manifest.

domains.summary: This domain is the agent's eyes inside the editor: it closes the postmortem's "no UE reflection-introspection tool" gap (which forces ~90% of sessions into hand-rolled python guessing class/property names) and productizes Hayba's crash-resilience and journal moats as readable health/observability probes. Strategy: lead with a full reflection layer (class/property/function/enum/struct/subclass discovery) so agents stop guessing, pair every write-domain mutation with a read-back/diff/verify tool (inspection-first invariant), and ship cheap gating probes (editor_state, log_watch_errors, wait_for_compile, mcp_health) that make unattended loops safe. Almost everything is python_run-backed pyTemplate descriptors (zero plugin rebuild) over UnrealEditor-scripting + AssetRegistry + the reflection system; only the live C++ command-table dump and the hot console/perf paths touch the plugin. We out-cover GenOrca/Roblox on introspection breadth while adding diff/verify/journal depth none of them have, and we speak docs-as-a-tool to match Houdini/remiphilippe.
dependencies: python_run handler (SEH-guarded) — backs ~32 of these descriptors with zero plugin rebuild; reflection/AssetRegistry/EditorActorSubsystem all run through it
Add-a-tool refactor (Theme 1): single ToolDescriptor with pyTemplate factory so these land as data, not 7-file churn; sidecar generated from descriptors
Code-Mode / deferred routing + packs: all 40 land behind the introspect pack so they never bloat the eager surface

Existing C++ handlers to extend (no new module needed for most): EditorHandler (log/console/camera readback), PerfHandler (perf_stats), SceneGraphHandler (outliner_tree/scene_stats), CommandHandler (new mcp_describe_commands)
Existing TS to wrap: check-ue-status.ts (mcp_health), dag/journal-tail.ts + dag/status.ts (action_journal), wait_for_idle/wait_for_shaders (wait_for_compile pattern)
Pagination + error-envelope conventions (limit/has_more/next_offset, machine codes) from the global design rules
DAG/journal store + hayba-memory.db for action_journal
AssetRegistryModule and the UE reflection system (UClass/FProperty/UFunction/UEnum/UStruct iteration) available in-editor
risks: Reflection iteration over huge classes/worlds can blow the 1MB TCP frame cap and waste context — every list tool MUST paginate hard (default 50) and filter server-side, not client-side

CDO access and force-loading assets during reflect_default_object / asset_registry_query can trigger sync loads or GC stalls on the game thread; keep reads shallow and prefer AssetRegistry tags over loading the asset
Property values that are object pointers/structs/arrays serialize poorly — need a typed, bounded value encoder with depth limits or object_inspect returns unreadable blobs
memreport/profilegpu/stat parsing is brittle across UE versions (pinned 5.7.0) — string-scraping console output may break on 5.8; flag gpu_profile/memory_report as best-effort
console_exec output capture races the async log sink; may miss lines emitted after the call returns — needs a short drain window or cursor read via log_tail
mcp_describe_commands requires a C++ rebuild and an honest command table; if it drifts from reality it reintroduces the false-advertising problem it was meant to kill
Some 'read' tools (cvar_set, stat_command, console_exec) are actually mutating and must respect Plan-Mode / not be classified as alwaysOn read-only despite living in this domain
editor_state / message_log_get during PIE or a blocking modal may itself hang the game thread — must go through the RunSync seam and short timeouts, never AsyncTask+Wait
domains.test_plan: Live-editor validation against a running UnrealEditor with HaybaMCPToolkit on the pinned 5.7 project: (1) Reflection — call reflect_search_types('StaticMeshActor'), then reflect_class / reflect_properties / reflect_functions on the result; assert StaticMeshComponent appears and property types/flags match the editor Details panel; reflect_enum on a known UEnum (e.g. ECollisionEnabled) and check entries. (2) Round-trip verify — spawn a StaticMeshActor (actor domain), object_inspect it, mutate RelativeLocation, object_get_property to confirm the new X, object_diff vs '@cdo' to confirm exactly one changed field. (3) Asset — asset_registry_query for /Game StaticMesh, asset_inspect one result, asset_dependencies(direction='refs'), asset_verify_exists on a mix of real+fake paths; confirm missing_count is right. (4) Scene/state — outliner_tree paginated (verify has_more/next_offset stitch a full list), selection_get after selecting actors in the viewport, editor_state before/after entering PIE and with a modal open, dirty_packages before+after a save. (5) Logs/diag — emit a known UE_LOG via console_exec, then log_tail(grep=...) and log_watch_errors(since_line) to confirm cursor advance; force a deliberate BP compile error and check compile_errors + message_log_get('Compiler'). (6) Perf/cvar — perf_stats sanity (fps>0, draw_calls>0), cvar_set('r.ScreenPercentage',50) then cvar_get to confirm applied==50, stat_command('unit'). (7) Meta — mcp_health asserts connected+plugin_version, action_journal shows the calls just made with durations, mcp_describe_commands lists the introspect commands with destructive flags; undo_history reflects the spawn/mutate transactions. Pagination, 1MB-frame, and timeout behavior checked by running outliner_tree/asset_registry_query on a large World Partition map. Each tool also gets a disconnected-editor run to confirm graceful error envelopes (machine codes, no hang).

tools.name: reflect_class
tools.parity: Roblox get_class_info (shallow); net-new moat for UE reflection depth
tools.signature: (class_path, include_inherited=true) -> {class, super_chain, flags, interfaces, components, cdo_summary}
tools.description: Describe a UClass: superclass chain, class flags, interfaces, default subobjects/components, and key CDO defaults — so agents stop guessing class shapes before spawning/editing.

tools.name: reflect_properties
tools.parity: net-new moat (no UE MCP exposes reflected property schemas)
tools.signature: (class_or_object, filter?, editable_only?, limit=50, offset=0) -> {properties[], has_more, next_offset}
tools.description: List a class/object's reflected UPROPERTYs with type, category, edit/BP flags, and metadata, filtered+paginated — the single biggest cure for the python-guessing loop.

tools.name: reflect_search_types
tools.description: Fuzzy-search the whole type system (native + asset classes, structs, enums) by name/keyword — turns 'what's the class called?' from a python fishing trip into one call.

tools.name: reflect_functions
tools.parity: chongdashu BP-graph (partial); net-new for call-surface listing
tools.description: List a class's UFUNCTIONs (BlueprintCallable/Pure/Event) with params, return type, and flags, paginated — needed before any BP-graph or call-function authoring.

tools.name: reflect_subclasses
tools.description: Enumerate concrete subclasses of a base (e.g. all Actor types, all spawnable components) so spawn/add-component tools can offer real, valid choices.

tools.name: reflect_default_object
tools.description: Dump the CDO property values for a class (what a fresh instance looks like) — the baseline for object_diff and for predicting spawn results.

tools.name: reflect_enum
tools.description: Enumerate a UEnum's entries with raw values + display names — lets agents pass valid enum literals instead of guessing ints.

tools.name: reflect_struct
tools.description: Describe a UStruct/USTRUCT's fields with types and defaults — needed to construct struct-typed property values correctly.

tools.name: object_inspect
tools.signature: (target, depth=1, filter?, limit=80, offset=0) -> {object, properties{}, has_more}
tools.description: Read the full property tree of a live object/actor (by id or path) with depth, filter, and pagination — the universal read-back primitive paired with every write op.

tools.name: object_get_property
tools.parity: Roblox get_attribute; net-new for dotted UE paths
tools.description: Read one property by dotted/indexed path (e.g. RootComponent.RelativeLocation.X) with typed value — surgical verify after a single mutation.

tools.name: object_diff
tools.description: Property-by-property diff of two objects, or object vs its CDO — the before/after verify that proves a mutation did exactly what was asked and nothing else.

tools.name: asset_inspect
tools.description: AssetRegistry metadata for one asset: class, registry tags, disk size, dirty flag, dependency/referencer counts — read before edit/delete to avoid surprises.

tools.name: asset_registry_query
tools.parity: Blender asset libs / GenOrca; net-new for tag queries
tools.signature: (class_filter?, path_prefix?, tag_filter?, recursive=true, limit=50, offset=0) -> {assets[], has_more, next_offset}
tools.description: Query the AssetRegistry by class/path-prefix/tag, paginated — discovery surface for 'what assets exist that I can use here'.

tools.name: asset_dependencies
tools.description: Walk the dependency or referencer graph of an asset to a given depth — prevents breaking refs before delete/rename and supports impact analysis.

tools.name: asset_verify_exists
tools.description: Batch existence + loadability check for a list of asset paths — the cheap gating read that confirms generated/imported assets actually landed.

tools.name: outliner_tree
tools.signature: (folder?, class_filter?, name_filter?, limit=50, offset=0) -> {nodes[], has_more, next_offset}
tools.description: Paginated world outliner: actors with label, class, folder, and attachment parent/children — the agent's map of the level without dumping the whole world.

tools.name: actor_inspect
tools.description: Full read-back of one actor: transform, components, material slots, tags, layers, data-layers — the inspection-first pair for the actor write domain.

tools.name: actor_components
tools.description: List an actor's components with class, attach parent, and a few key props, paginated — needed before component-level edits or transform fixes.

tools.name: selection_get
tools.description: Return the current editor selection (level actors, selected components, content-browser assets) — context probe so 'apply to selection' tools know their target.

tools.name: scene_stats
tools.description: Aggregate scene budget: actor counts by class, total/instanced primitives, triangle estimate, missing-LOD hotspots — observability for perf-driven worldbuilding.

tools.name: editor_state
tools.description: One-shot consolidated editor status: active mode, current map, PIE/play-world state, blocking-modal flag, dirty-package count — the master gating probe before any action loop.

tools.name: dirty_packages
tools.description: List unsaved/dirty packages and assets — verify what would be written before a save/build/cook, and confirm a save actually cleaned them.

tools.name: viewport_state
tools.module: C++ HaybaMCPToolkit/EditorHandler (extend editor_set_camera readback) + TS wrapper
tools.description: Read the active level viewport: camera transform, FOV, view mode, realtime flag, and enabled show-flags — context for capture/render tools and for reproducing a view.

tools.name: level_info
tools.description: Current persistent level plus sublevels, streaming/data-layer state, and World Partition loaded-cell summary — observability for WP/data-layer worldbuilding.

tools.name: log_tail
tools.description: Tail recent editor log lines with severity + category filter and grep, cursor-paginated — the core observability read for diagnosing what the editor just did.

tools.name: log_watch_errors
tools.description: Return only Warnings/Errors emitted since a cursor — the cheap poll an unattended agent runs after each mutation to catch silent failures without paging full logs.

tools.name: message_log_get
tools.description: Read paginated pages of the UE Message Log (PIE, Compiler, MapCheck, AssetCheck) — structured editor diagnostics that never reach the raw output log.

tools.name: compile_errors
tools.description: Return the last Blueprint/Material/shader compile errors with asset + node/pin context — feeds the self-correcting authoring loop Aura markets.

tools.name: wait_for_compile
tools.description: Block (job-envelope, polled) until pending Blueprint/material/shader compilation settles, then report success/error counts — gating so reads don't race a half-compiled asset.

tools.name: perf_stats
tools.signature: (deep=false) -> {fps, frame_ms, game_ms, render_ms, gpu_ms, draw_calls, primitives, memory_mb}
tools.description: Snapshot FPS, frame/game/render/GPU ms, draw calls, primitives, and memory — observability that lets the agent catch perf regressions it introduced.

tools.name: memory_report
tools.description: Engine memory breakdown: UObject count, GC stats, texture/mesh/RT pool sizes (parsed memreport) — diagnoses the leaks and bloat that crash long sessions.

tools.name: stat_command
tools.description: Toggle and read back a 'stat' group (unit/fps/gpu/rhi/streaming), returning parsed values rather than just flipping the on-screen overlay.

tools.name: gpu_profile
tools.description: Capture a single-frame GPU timing breakdown (profilegpu) parsed into named passes with ms — deep perf observability for render-heavy scenes.

tools.name: cvar_get
tools.description: Read a console variable's current value, default, and flags — diagnostics and gating (e.g. confirm Lumen/Nanite cvars are in the expected state).

tools.name: cvar_set
tools.description: Set a console variable and read back the applied value — verified config change instead of a fire-and-forget console command.

tools.name: cvar_list
tools.description: Search/list console variables by prefix with help text, paginated — discovery so agents find the right knob instead of guessing cvar names.

tools.name: console_exec
tools.description: Run an arbitrary console command and capture the log lines it produced in-window — observable console execution (vs blind editor_run_console_command).

tools.name: undo_history
tools.parity: Roblox undo/redo (read side); net-new for UE
tools.description: Read the editor transaction (undo/redo) stack — labels and current index — so the agent can see what a Ctrl+Z would revert before invoking the transaction domain.

tools.name: mcp_health
tools.module: TS (extends check-ue-status.ts; no plugin call beyond ping)
tools.description: Consolidated server+plugin health: TCP connect, plugin/protocol version, sidecar status, idle/shader state, in-flight command count — surfaces the crash-resilience moat as one probe.

tools.name: mcp_describe_commands
tools.description: Enumerate the running plugin's live C++ command table with param schemas and destructive flags — closes field-level schema drift and makes the sidecar generatable from the editor.

tools.name: action_journal
tools.description: Query the MCP action journal/DAG: recent tool calls with args, result status, duration, and errors, paginated — observability of what the agent itself did, productizing the journal moat.

domains.summary: Today this domain is 8 thin commands (start/stop PIE, 4 pie_* runtime primitives, 3 test_* commands) carrying a P0 freeze: test_run blocks the game thread up to 120s/test and PIE wait-loops pump the ticker synchronously. Strategy is three-layered. (1) THEME-0 fix: convert test_run and long PIE waits to the job-envelope pattern (start -> poll) so the whole domain is non-blocking and unattended-safe, a reliability moat nobody documents. (2) Close parity fast by surfacing ~25 missing runtime-control verbs (input action/axis/mouse, possess/teleport/spawn, line-trace/overlap, stats/screenshot-diff) mostly as python_run wrappers with zero plugin rebuild. (3) Own the high ground with outcome verbs (pie_run_scenario drives a whole playtest with assertions + before/after vision diff in one journaled call) and declarative dry-run test plans validated through PLUMB. Every write tool ships a paired read/inspect tool (pie_status, pie_get_player_state, pie_get_actors) per the inspection-first rule.
dependencies: THEME-0 job-envelope conversion (docs/audit/2026-06-22-mcp-async-command-conversions.md) - hard prerequisite for test_run_async/pie_job_poll
THEME-1 add-a-tool refactor + pyTemplate factory for the python_run-backed wrappers
Hardened python_run handler (SEH + security gate) - vehicle for all PY tools
SEH-wrap ProcessCommand so PIE/test handler crashes are recoverable
Existing PIE world resolver (GetPIEWorld) and reflected-property read/compare in HaybaMCPPIEHandler.cpp
Vision tools (editor_capture_viewport/render_camera) + visual sidecar for screenshot-diff/CLIP
PLUMB validator for dry-run test-plan validation
Enhanced Input plugin (for pie_input_action) - fall back to legacy action/axis mappings if absent
journal + DAG for scenario/test-run history
risks: PIE runs on the game thread; any synchronous wait re-introduces the freeze - all long waits MUST go through the job envelope, not a blocking loop
PIE world is transient: spawned actors and possessed pawns vanish on stop; tools must not promise persistence and must re-resolve the world each call (GEditor->PlayWorld can be null mid-transition)
Input injection differs between Enhanced Input and legacy mappings; action-name lookups can silently no-op - return a dispatched=false + reason rather than fake success
Automation-test API churn (UE 5.7 StartTestByName returns void); pin behavior and flag engine-version sensitivity
Screenshot capture currently waits on file write (PIEScreenshot TODO) - racy; prefer OnScreenshotCaptured buffer path for the diff tool
Determinism: real-time PIE makes frame-exact asserts flaky; pie_step_frames + time-dilation mitigate but can't fully fix physics jitter
pie_eval is an escape hatch inside a live game world - must respect the python security gate and Plan-Mode before mutating
Multiplayer/dedicated-server PIE spawns extra processes - resource and teardown hazards; gate behind P3
domains.test_plan: Live-editor validation on a real map with a player pawn. (1) pie_start mode=play, then pie_status to confirm world/num_players; prove non-blocking by polling pie_job_poll while a long pie_wait_for is in flight. (2) Movement: pie_input_axis MoveForward 1.0 for 1s, pie_get_player_state confirms location delta; pie_input_action jump, pie_assert_property velocity.Z spike. (3) pie_spawn_actor a trigger, pie_teleport_player onto it, pie_overlap_query confirms overlap, pie_line_trace down confirms ground hit. (4) pie_capture_screenshot then pie_screenshot_diff vs committed baseline; eyeball the PNG block + diff score. (5) pie_capture_stats during movement confirms fps/frame_ms. (6) test_run_async on a known-pass + known-fail automation test, poll pie_job_poll, verify passed/failed buckets and test_get_log errors. (7) pie_run_scenario end-to-end (start->macro->asserts->diff->stop) returns one report; confirm a single failed assert marks the run failed. (8) pie_stop, then pie_status confirms torn down.

tools.name: pie_status

tools.signature: () -> {running, paused, mode, world, num_players, elapsed_s, map}

tools.name: pie_job_poll
tools.description: Poll a long-running PIE/test job (started, running, done, failed) and fetch results when complete; the read half of the job envelope that ends game-thread freezes.

tools.name: test_run_async

tools.name: test_list

tools.description: List discovered automation tests with category/path/source filters, paginated; the inspect tool for the test runner.

tools.name: test_get_log
tools.description: Return per-test errors/warnings/duration from the last run; the read-back that turns a pass/fail into actionable diagnostics.

tools.name: pie_assert_property

tools.description: Assert a reflected actor property equals an expected value (with tolerance), waiting up to a timeout; core gameplay correctness check.

tools.name: pie_wait_for

tools.signature: (actor_path|actor_label, property_name, comparator, expected_value, tolerance?, timeout_ms?) -> {matched, observed_value, frames}

tools.name: pie_capture_screenshot

tools.parity: Flop/Roblox capture_screenshot; moat = image content blocks

tools.name: pie_scrape_log
